Features:
1. more than 70 solid meals recipes for babies from 6-12 months
2. filter recipes by age (6-8 months, 8-10 months, 10-12 months)
3. filter recipes by meal time (breakfast, lunch and dinner)
4. simple step-by-step instructions
5. save and categorize recipes as favorites
6. search recipes by title or ingredient name
7. practical shopping list on the go to remember
8. share recipe via social network

Your "Baby Food Team" wishes you and your baby good appetite!
